target: spine on the petiole: no exact PO class; spine leaf (PO_0025173) is closest, with the petiole (PO_0020038) as the whole
fix: 'spines' on a cycad petiole are reduced leaflets, not thorns. Thorn (PO_0025172) is a modified shoot. Do not ground 'spine' to thorn; read 'spines' after 'petiole ... spiny' as parts of the petiole.
